ambient: A cue comes round and passes.
Somebody in the wings mouths something helpful and it isn't words.
The audience settles the way an audience settles when it's going well.
description: A stage, mid-run, and you're on. The others are doing it well and have done it many times. Your part is substantial. They pause where your lines go and then carry on generously, covering, in a way that's becoming its own performance.
name: The Rehearsal

looks: Word perfect. They have been carrying this section for a while.
One of them takes your line and gives it a reading you wouldn't have chosen.
They're pleased to see you and haven't broken character to be.
objects.name: the others

looks: On a table at the side of the stage, open at the place.
Your name down the left. The right-hand column has been left blank for you.
You have annotated it. In pencil. Recently.
objects.name: the script

weather: Hot in a small circle and cold everywhere else.
